materiality.rationale: Agent-scale development breaks human-scale tooling: 10x merge growth forced a 5-month VCS rewrite with server-centric design. Reader learns the principles (always-online, sparse-by-design, API-first) and the boundary (internal monorepo only, not a git replacement). Engineering narrative essentially complete. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]
